title: PersonaAgent: Retrieval-Augmented Transaction Anomaly Scoring with Refreshable Multi-Entity Persona Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.08094v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In large-scale payment networks, entities (card, merchant, etc.) and their interactions play a key role in transaction anomaly detection. However, transaction patterns between different entities usually change more frequently than the production model refresh schedule. Meanwhile, entity embedding tables suffer from high-cardinality and sparse interaction issues. To resolve the above challenges, we present PersonaAgent, an agentic transaction anomaly detection framework which represents the latest entity behavior signals as personas and saves them in a refreshable memory. Offline, a weekly scheduled batch job is used to extract the latest behavior signals and update them in the memory. At inference time, a lightweight adapter retrieves the corresponding entity behavior signals of each transaction from memory and uses them to augment the base anomaly classifier's scoring. translated_title: PersonaAgent：基于可刷新多实体角色记忆的检索增强交易异常评分
translated_abstract: 在大规模支付网络中，实体（卡、商户等）及其交互在交易异常检测中起着关键作用。然而，不同实体之间的交易模式通常比生产模型的刷新计划变化得更加频繁。同时，实体嵌入表还面临高基数与稀疏交互的问题。为了解决上述挑战，我们提出了PersonaAgent，这是一个智能体式的交易异常检测框架，它将最新的实体行为信号表示为角色并保存在可刷新的记忆中。在离线阶段，通过每周定时运行的批处理任务提取最新的行为信号并更新到记忆中。在推理阶段，轻量级适配器从记忆中检索每笔交易对应的实体行为信号，并用它们来增强基础异常分类器的评分。通过与不同异常检测方法进行全面的基准测试……
tldr: PersonaAgent通过将实体最新行为信号以角色形式存储在可刷新的多实体记忆中，并在推理时由轻量级适配器检索以增强基础异常分类器的评分，有效解决了交易模式频繁变化与实体嵌入高基数稀疏的挑战。
en_tdlr: PersonaAgent stores the latest entity behavior signals as refreshable multi-entity personas in memory, which a lightweight adapter retrieves at inference time to augment a base anomaly classifier's scoring, addressing fast-changing transaction patterns and high-cardinality sparse entity embeddings.
